objective: Build the Lantern Express server: run lifecycle, the train with seats and the seated rule, stops from the tile kit with prompts, carrying, the fog, nights with the Aim remote and server hit tests, rewards to each player's own save, and the weekly boards, on part fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Files as architecture 4.1; Router actions, prompts, the Aim remote, Fx and LanternRun attributes exactly as decision 0018 section 3; the server ignores Fx.OnServerEvent
The seated rule: two Studio clients, jumping while the train moves re-seats within 0.5 s and the train never stops for it; a menu player who sits is stood up
A full run in Studio solo and with 2 to 3 test players reaches Dawn Station on part fallbacks; ending by coal and by lantern returns everyone to the hub with every load paid
Every reward is a saves.apply on one player's own save with captured inputs; leaving mid-leg and rejoining keeps every load (Studio with DataStores on, notes with the build stamp)
Aim: NaN, a non-Vector3, length 2, a sender outside a turret and a 100 Hz stream are refused or dropped; the hit test uses only server wisp positions
src/relay/Models.luau reads LanternAssets in three places and Relay, Night and Garden keep their behaviour; the server warns when Players.MaxPlayers is above 6
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua --check, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; rojo build lantern.project.json and check-place pass
verification: CI, Studio notes with the build stamp (rule 13), and the LANTERN-013 QA review
notes: Deviations (for LANTERN-013 and the checkpoint): (1) the train is 0018's fallback, anchored cars moved by CFrame (the brief), not Align constraints; two-client jitter is LANTERN-012's check. (2) The stop frame follows the art's LAYOUT (tiles.py): origin on the deck's track edge 4 studs out at the plate top, +Z into the stop, at the stop distance; the deck (depth <= 10) is never caught by the fog. The LANTERN-007 client assumes ClientState.STOP_EDGE = 14: it should be 4 (or read the Stop model's Site attribute). (3) LanternConfig.TILES is the art's LAYOUT (Director, 2026-11-06), with block names and lamps; the spec pins it. (4) Fx adds `shoo { target }` for the LANTERN-007 client and the carry refusal codes gone/taken/hands/big reach players as notices: decision 0018 section 3 needs an amendment (rule 8). (5) Newer saves: the server passes `newer = LanternProgress.isNewer` to Saves.start (LANTERN-005, now on game6/concept); on this branch's older kit a guard in the server's sanitize aborts the load write instead and is switched off when the kit keeps the option. (6) Weekly boards show display names (GDD G5) via UserService, not GetNameFromUserIdAsync. (7) Lighting.Technology is not scriptable: set Future in lantern.project.json (LANTERN-002) or the place settings. (8) src/shared/LanternAssets.luau is left to the generator (Director): Models.luau loads it optionally. Not verified here: two-player runs, a full three-leg run to Dawn Station, ending by lantern, and leave/rejoin persistence (needs DataStores: a published staging place).
evidence: Local gates 2026-11-06: lune run tests/run 715/715; selene src tests 0 errors 0 warnings; stylua --check on LF copies clean; validate-tasks; check-scope origin/main; rojo build lantern.project.json + check-place matches (see the commit for the counts).
